# ListItem

Individual list item

## Overview

- **Category**: data-display
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: ListItem

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { ListItem } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<ListItem>
  <ListItemText primary="Primary Text" secondary="Secondary Text" />
</ListItem>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<ListItem>
  <ListItemText primary="Primary Text" secondary="Secondary Text" />
</ListItem>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's ListItem.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI ListItem Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/listitem/)
